app.title: Star Tracker Pipeline — Interactive Walkthrough
app.summary: A person picks a test sky image from a list, or uploads one with its calibration label, and chooses whether to replay a stored run or run the solver live. They can set the detection threshold and the pause between stages. Pressing Run plays the pipeline one stage at a time, each with an overlay or a table: detected sources, the brightest subset turned into direction vectors, the matched catalog triangle, the first rotation, and the iterative refinement. It ends with a pass/fail quality gate and a final attitude, compared with the ground truth as an angular error and an overlay of matched pairs.

task.text: Watch an image-to-attitude solver work through each stage on one image, and check its final orientation estimate against the ground truth.

data.text: Grayscale sky images, each with a label holding the camera calibration and ground-truth pointing, matched against a star catalog table
data.item: one sky image with its calibration and ground-truth label

stage.text: checking a trained detection-and-matching pipeline on held-out images, after training

mechanism.text: A sidebar sets the input image, live or replay mode, the threshold and the pacing. The main column then shows one collapsible status block per pipeline stage, in order, each with an image overlay, a small table or the key numbers, and ends with summary metrics and a predicted-versus-truth table.

field.text: lost-in-space star identification and attitude determination in astronomy

workflow.name: run a multi-stage solver on one item and judge its result against a reference

steps.here: Pick a test-set PNG from a dropdown, or upload a PNG with its JSON label, which holds the WCS and the ground truth. Replay mode locks you to images that have stored artefacts.
The input image is shown with metrics for size, plate scale, boresight RA/Dec and the number of ground-truth stars before anything runs

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: The U-Net finds centroids on 512 px tiles, drawn as red circles, with an optional heatmap of the centre tile. The 60 brightest are kept and turned into distortion-corrected body unit vectors, with a sample table.

steps.step: match items against a reference set
steps.here: A RANSAC triangle search matches three detections to three catalog stars by their pairwise angles. The triangle is drawn in lime, with a table of body and catalog angles.
A Wahba SVD gives a rough rotation matrix. A plate solve then refits RA, Dec and roll as the matching tolerance tightens (30, then 5, then 1.5 px), and each pass is logged in a history table.

steps.step: check the result against the reference and pass or fail it
steps.here: The quality gate needs a median residual under 2 px and at least 8 matches. The final angular error against the truth, a predicted-versus-truth pose table, and an overlay of detections linked to projected catalog stars are shown. Stored failures are shown as refusals.

distinctive: Replay and Live modes give the same numbers: replay renders stored artefacts instantly, while live mode runs a solver that can take minutes
A quality gate refuses to publish an unreliable attitude, and a recorded refusal is shown as the intended output rather than an error
Pixels are turned into direction vectors through the camera's distortion polynomial before they are matched against the catalog
An animation delay paces the stages so each result can be read before the next appears
